notes: Redo of the nurse + travel run (user 2026-10-30): inspiration now taken from the most eye-catching direct-response statics of Hike and Stepprs (rivals contact sheet), not the generic wellness list. Nurse colors only Black/Purple, Black/White, All Black, White Blue. 7%+ text margin on every edge.

concepts.format_source: Stepprs '12 years of nerve pain gone instantly' written on the sole (top 2.0%, 407 days)
concepts.headline: 12 YEARS OF 12s. FINALLY COMFORTABLE.
concepts.angle: Nurse with years of 12-hour shifts: message written on the sole of her foot
concepts.prompt: A real, warm close-up photo in a living room: a woman's bare foot raised toward the camera showing the sole, with thick black marker handwriting written directly on the sole in four lines: "12 YEARS" / "OF 12s." / "FINALLY" / "COMFORTABLE." Next to the foot, a pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference resting on a soft rug, large, sharp, true proportions. Navy scrub pants visible at the ankle. Natural window light, realistic skin texture. All text is huge, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+, with at least 7% clear margin between every text element and every edge of the image. No other text anywhere.
concepts.based_on: Hike/Stepprs active statics contact sheet 2026-10-30 (rivals pull); copy from Emily RN winner, travel winners, survey/Trustpilot language
